tInstall.addr: 2596 Francisco Dr, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762, USA
tInstall.description:
Terry Klassen - Valve manifold re-build
AM Loading:
- PVC repair kit & full cans of primer and blue glue
- Clean rags - 4-5x
- 1" PVC - at least 30'
- Digging, tamping tools + hard rake
- Ewing irrigation parts box (see David)
- 1" PVC parts box
- Tape measure
- Black zip ties - 20x
- Mini-sledge
- 6" boat level
- Water-proof wire nuts - small & medium
- 18/5 control wire: at least 20'
- Wire stripper/snips
- Electrical tape, roll
- 8x 1/2"x36" rebar pieces (see David)

System flushing:
- Can flush after 30 mins cure time for final connection - make sure nothing remains under constant pressure at any point - always have outlet

Controller testing:
- Make sure all existing valve connections are wired back to zones on controller. If wires get messed up, you will need to verify that all lawn/sprayer zones still correspond to lawn/sprayer valves, drip to drip valves, etc... 
- Turn controller ON and verify programs with David before leaving site

Backfill/finishing:
- Photograph all install piping and control valve manifold PRIOR TO backfill for accountability
- Bolster/pack in soil under all non-supported pipes
- Tamp soil over pipes in 6" lifts
- Topdress with buckets of black chip mulch and rinse region to complete with hose (mud on fence, a/c unit, hardscapes, etc...

Instructions for client: overnight glue cure time
- Wait to pressurize system until Saturday morning - anytime after 3am okay
- Turn on via main ball-valve slowly until fully open
- Manually run first valve and last valve in sequence from 1/4-turn solenoid to burp system pressure. 
- Controller should run system from here forward as long as dial is set to run/auto
